parsed.summary: Tracing the drawing against the specification, every functional element matches: the two 2x15 bus connectors pass the same nets through, the external-5V jack is gated by the SS54 Schottky into +5V and the +5V rail is fed to the servo rail by the PMEG3030EP (correct orientations and forward-voltage notes), four 100 uF caps plus the 0.1 uF MAX3485 decoupler are present, the P-MOSFET/SPDT battery switch and the BC857 self-switching MAX3485 direction circuit with its 10k/5.1k/47k/2k/20k/2.2k/2.2k bias network are intact, and the PWM-selection 0 ohm jumpers, the 1k series resistors, and the serial-bridge 0 ohm jumpers all carry the values the spec states. The reference designators are renumbered relative to the spec (e.g. bus = J7/J8, servos = J1/J4, SS54 = D3, PMEG = D1, MOSFET = Q2, BC857 = Q3, MAX3485 = U2, jumpers = R130/R190), but the part types, values, notes and connectivity all agree with the intended design, so I find no drawing-supported deviation.
